name: Amazon Polly
positioning: AWS's managed text-to-speech service offering Standard, Neural, Long-Form and Generative voice engines with SSML, lexicons and speech marks.

pricing.model: Pay per character of text converted to speech or Speech Marks, billed monthly; cached and replayed generated speech is free.
pricing.headline: Standard $4 per 1M characters; Neural $16; Generative $30; Long-Form $100.
pricing.headlineTier: Standard voices (5M free characters per month)

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Free tier 5 million characters per month. Confirmed by AWS price list (us-east-1) at $0.000004 per character.

tiers.name: Neural
tiers.notes: Free tier 1 million characters per month for the first 12 months. AWS price list confirms $0.000016 per character.

tiers.name: Generative
tiers.notes: Speech requests only. Free tier 100 thousand characters per month for the first 12 months. AWS price list confirms $0.00003 per character.

tiers.name: Long-Form
tiers.notes: Free tier 500 thousand characters per month for the first 12 months. AWS price list confirms $0.0001 per character.

pricing.freeTier: Standard: 5M characters per month; Neural: 1M per month for 12 months; Long-Form: 500K per month for 12 months; Generative: 100K per month for 12 months. New AWS customers (from July 15, 2025) also receive up to $200 in Free Tier credits (free plan for 6 months, credits usable within 12 months).

voices.languages: 42 language and language-variant rows in the available-voices table
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Brand Voice: custom voice built with AWS on request via an AWS account manager or contact form; cost and timeline scoped per engagement. No self-serve cloning stated on pages read.

streaming.vendorStatedLatency: Qualitative only: 'consistently fast response times' (no figure) at https://aws.amazon.com/polly/features/

compatibility.note: Native API is SynthesizeSpeech with Engine, VoiceId, OutputFormat, Text and TextType (SSML or text), signed with AWS credentials (SigV4); a bidirectional StartSpeechSynthesisStream over HTTP/2 exists. No OpenAI-compatible mode found in pages read.

licensing.commercialUse: Features page lists the ability to securely store and redistribute speech in standard formats; pricing page states generated speech can be cached and replayed at no additional cost.

limits.perRequestCharacters: SynthesizeSpeech: up to 3,000 billed characters (6,000 total; SSML tags not billed); output stream limited to 10 minutes. Longer text uses asynchronous speech synthesis tasks.
limits.concurrency: SynthesizeSpeech: Standard 80 tps (80 concurrent), Neural 8 tps (18 concurrent), Long-Form 8 tps (26 concurrent), Generative 8 tps (26 concurrent).

compliance.note: Self-attested: Polly FAQ states it is a HIPAA Eligible Service covered under the AWS Business Associate Addendum. SOC 2 and GDPR not found on pages read.

strengths.claim: Very low entry price: Standard voices at $4 per 1M characters with 5M free characters per month.
Four voice engines (Standard, Neural, Long-Form, Generative) so cost and naturalness can be matched per use case.
Speech Marks metadata (sentence, word, viseme, SSML) for synchronized highlighting and lip-sync, plus lexicons for pronunciation.
HIPAA Eligible Service under the AWS BAA.
Generated speech can be cached and replayed at no additional cost.

limitations.claim: SynthesizeSpeech input is capped at 3,000 billed characters (6,000 total) and 10 minutes of audio per call.
The limits page lists the bidirectional StartSpeechSynthesisStream operation under Generative voice.
Brand Voice is offered through an engagement with AWS rather than self-serve.

stepsToMove: Endpoint: Polly SynthesizeSpeech takes JSON {Engine, VoiceId, OutputFormat, Text, TextType, SampleRate, LexiconNames} signed with AWS SigV4; ReadAloud takes the OpenAI speech request (POST /v1/audio/speech) or the ElevenLabs route with an API key.
Voice ids: Polly VoiceIds (Joanna, Matthew, Ruth...) and Engine selection map to ReadAloud voice and model choices; pick explicitly.
SSML and lexicons: Polly lexicons and SSML (TextType=ssml) have no direct equivalent; convert to plain text or verify ReadAloud's documented SSML handling.
Speech marks: if you use OutputFormat=json (word, sentence, viseme), check whether ReadAloud's streaming alignment covers your need.
Formats: Polly OutputFormat values mp3, ogg_vorbis, ogg_opus, pcm, mulaw, alaw map to ReadAloud response_format or output_format choices; confirm the supported subset.
Chunking: Polly splits long text at 3,000 billed characters per call; ReadAloud limits may differ.

bestFor: Teams on AWS who need low-cost, high-volume speech for IVR, notifications or accessibility, plus speech marks metadata and HIPAA-eligible handling.
